name: Email S4 - agent sessions, open network: four scaffolds, five briefs, two models
_note: S4 of the email study (docs/EMAIL-PREREG.md): how Claude Code comes to choose an email provider
when asked to add email to a real project. 4 scaffolds x 5 briefs x 2 models x 3 repeats = 120 runs.
Not a ranking of providers. The scaffolds are built by `npm run scaffolds` into out/scaffolds/ and
pinned by the SHA that command prints; a test rebuilds them and checks these pins.
Image aeo-sandbox:email is aeo-sandbox:s1 plus Ruby 3.3 for the Rails scaffold
(sandbox/Dockerfile.email). Build it, then pin its digest under sandbox.digest on every surface
and re-plan: until then the preflight warns that no digest is pinned.
Effort is pinned to high on both models, as in the hosting seasons. If the pinned CLI release
does not serve one of the models, the preflight's probe says so; rebuild with a newer release
and change claudeVersion on every email wave file before the first definitive run.
post.manifests keeps every dependency manifest as cloned and as the run left it.
Plan, then run: npm run plan -- waves/email-s4-open.json; npm run run-wave -- --wave N --limit 3
